page.overview:
Who is Della Leiter?

Della Leiter was the wife of CIA operative, Felix Leiter. The character appeared briefly in the story "One Pistol, Three Silencers" in Dynamite Entertainment's 2020 James Bond graphic novel, Reflections of Death.

In November 2020, Miss Moneypenny related an event involving the Leiter family to her SMERSH captor during a drug-assisted interrogation. As a possible unreliable narrator, the veracity of Moneypenny's tale is unclear. Della Leiter was the wife of CIA operative Felix Leiter and mother to Cedar and Kelsey Leiter. They shared a close friendship with Felix's MI6 colleague, James Bond, and effectively took him in as family after the death of his wife Teresa. At some point between Kelsey's sixth and eighteenth birthday, Della passed away. The cause of death was not disclosed.
